content: ध्वजवत् {%a.%} .²1 Adorned with flags. .²2 Having a mark. .²3 Having the mark of a criminal, branded; शिरःकपाली ध्वजवान्भिक्षाशी कर्म वेदयन् <ls>Y. 3. 243</ls>. --{%m.%} .²1 A standard-bearer. .²2 A vendor of spirituous liquors, distiller; <ls>Ms. 4. 84</ls>. .²3 A Brāhmaṇa who carries with him the skull of the man murdered by him to places of pilgrimage by way of penance; <ab>cf.</ab> <ab>com.</ab> on <ls>Y. 3. 243</ls>.
